Pickup Window Route

Set the same-day departure and latest return, enter each stop's pickup window and service time, then fill in the directed travel minutes; press “Find a pickup route” to get the earliest-return visit order and the waiting time at each stop.

Departure and return

Format HH:MM, e.g. 08:00. 24:00 is only allowed for the latest return or a closing time.

Pickup stops

1–8 stops. Each stop needs a code, a pickup window and a service time.

Directed travel-time matrix (minutes)

Rows are the origin, columns the destination; 0 is the departure point, 1…n follow stop order. The diagonal is fixed at 0. Tick “No direct route” where a direction cannot be travelled.

The sample is fixed placeholder data (B first, then A, back by 08:50); press “Find a pickup route” after loading to calculate.
